SELECT d.business_date AS businessDate, IFNULL(c.card_income, 0) AS cardIncome, IFNULL(p.product_income, 0) AS productIncome, IFNULL(s.service_income, 0) AS serviceIncome, IFNULL(bc.cnt, 0) AS billCount FROM (SELECT DISTINCT business_date FROM bill WHERE business_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to}) d LEFT JOIN (SELECT business_date, SUM(received_cent) AS card_income FROM bill WHERE bill_type='CARD' AND status='SETTLED' GROUP BY business_date) c ON c.business_date = d.business_date LEFT JOIN (SELECT b.business_date, SUM(i.amount_cent) AS product_income FROM bill_item i JOIN bill b ON b.id = i.bill_id WHERE b.bill_type='SALE' AND b.status='SETTLED' AND i.item_type='PRODUCT' AND i.paid_by_card=0 GROUP BY b.business_date) p ON p.business_date = d.business_date LEFT JOIN (SELECT b.business_date, SUM(i.amount_cent) AS service_income FROM bill_item i JOIN bill b ON b.id = i.bill_id WHERE b.bill_type='SALE' AND b.status='SETTLED' AND i.item_type IN ('SERVICE','BOARDING') AND i.paid_by_card=0 GROUP BY b.business_date) s ON s.business_date = d.business_date
LEFT JOIN (SELECT business_date, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM bill WHERE bill_type='SALE' AND status='SETTLED' GROUP BY business_date) bc ON bc.business_date = d.business_date ORDER BY d.business_date ASC

SELECT b.business_date AS businessDate, SUM(pl.unit_cost_cent * (-pl.qty_change)) AS productCost FROM product_ledger pl JOIN bill b ON b.id = pl.ref_id WHERE pl.ref_type = 'BILL' AND pl.biz_type = 'SALE' AND b.bill_type='SALE' AND b.status='SETTLED' AND b.business_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} GROUP BY b.business_date
